details:
Q1: Which confirmed CI failures should this issue's PR fix?
Choices:
A) Both confirmed failures: make `gh_retry` return non-zero when the successful attempt's output can't be delivered (fixing `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`, not weakening `tests/test_gh_retry_stdout_isolation.py`), and make the no-docker-bin setup in `test_missing_docker_fails_closed_and_never_runs_host_codex` skip a target that already exists even when it points at a missing file. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Only the `gh_retry` failure. Leave `tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py` to open PR #9293 (issue #9286).
C) No code change. Close this issue as a duplicate of #9246/#9293 and re-run CI on `ai/issue-9255` once they're on the default branch.
**Note:** C makes Q2 irrelevant.
Q2: Should the `date +%s%3N` read at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:39` (the heartbeat clock the issue body suspects) also switch to `EPOCHREALTIME`, the way PR #9274 did for `review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh`?
Choices:
A) No. The traceback shows a different `orchestrate-poll (2)` failure, so leave line 39 alone and keep scope to the confirmed failures. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Yes. Harden line 39 with `EPOCHREALTIME` first and `date` as the fallback, plus a regression test, in the same PR.
**Note:** B together with Q1:C contradicts "no code change" and would need re-clarification.
